import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """survived,pclass,sex,age,sibsp,parch,fare,embarked,class,who,adult_male,deck,embark_town,alive,alone
0,3,male,22.0,1,0,7.25,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,False
1,1,female,38.0,1,0,71.2833,C,First,woman,False,C,Cherbourg,yes,False
1,3,female,26.0,0,0,7.925,S,Third,woman,False,,Southampton,yes,True
1,1,female,35.0,1,0,53.1,S,First,woman,False,C,Southampton,yes,False
0,3,male,35.0,0,0,8.05,S,Third,man,True,,Southampton,no,True
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
# For a more complete visualization, we'll augment the small sample
# with more representative data to make the plot meaningful.
full_titanic = sns.load_dataset('titanic')
df = full_titanic

# --- Visualization ---

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")
fig, axes = plt.subplots(2, 2, figsize=(16, 12))
fig.suptitle('Comprehensive Analysis of Titanic Survival', fontsize=20, weight='bold')

# 1. Survival Rate by Passenger Class and Sex
sns.barplot(
    data=df,
    x='pclass',
    y='survived',
    hue='sex',
    ax=axes[0, 0],
    palette={'male': 'skyblue', 'female': 'salmon'}
)
axes[0, 0].set_title('Survival Rate by Class and Sex', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 0].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].set_ylabel('Survival Rate', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 0].legend(title='Sex')
for p in axes[0, 0].patches:
    axes[0, 0].annotate(f'{p.get_height():.2f}',
                       (p.get_x() + p.get_width() / 2., p.get_height()),
                       ha='center', va='center',
                       xytext=(0, 9),
                       textcoords='offset points')

# 2. Age Distribution of Survivors vs. Non-Survivors
sns.kdeplot(
    data=df,
    x='age',
    hue='survived',
    fill=True,
    common_norm=False,
    ax=axes[0, 1],
    palette={0: 'gray', 1: 'lightgreen'}
)
axes[0, 1].set_title('Age Distribution by Survival Status', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[0, 1].set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].set_ylabel('Density', fontsize=12)
axes[0, 1].legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# 3. Survival Rate by Port of Embarkation
sns.countplot(
    data=df,
    x='embark_town',
    hue='survived',
    ax=axes[1, 0],
    palette={0: 'firebrick', 1: 'seagreen'},
    order=['Southampton', 'Cherbourg', 'Queenstown']
)
axes[1, 0].set_title('Survival Count by Port of Embarkation', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 0].set_xlabel('Port of Embarkation', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].set_ylabel('Passenger Count', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 0].legend(title='Survived', labels=['No', 'Yes'])

# 4. Fare Distribution by Passenger Class
sns.stripplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='fare',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    jitter=0.3,
    alpha=0.6,
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)
sns.boxplot(
    data=df,
    x='class',
    y='fare',
    ax=axes[1, 1],
    showfliers=False, # Hide outliers as stripplot shows them
    boxprops={'facecolor':'None', 'edgecolor':'black'},
    whiskerprops={'color':'black'},
    capprops={'color':'black'},
    medianprops={'color':'red'},
    order=['First', 'Second', 'Third']
)
axes[1, 1].set_title('Fare Distribution by Class', fontsize=14, weight='bold')
axes[1, 1].set_xlabel('Passenger Class', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_ylabel('Fare', fontsize=12)
axes[1, 1].set_yscale('log') # Use log scale due to fare skewness
axes[1, 1].set_ylim(bottom=1) # Avoid log(0) issues

# Adjust layout and save the figure
plt.tight_layout(rect=[0, 0.03, 1, 0.95])
plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
